verses.en: Make haste, O God, to deliver me; make haste to help me, O LORD.
verses.pt: Apressa-te, ó Deus, em me livrar; Senhor, apressa-te em socorrer-me.
verses.en_web: Hurry, God, to deliver me. Come quickly to help me, Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: <To the chief music-maker. Of David. To keep in memory.> Let your salvation come quickly, O God; come quickly to my help, O Lord.

verses.en: Let them be ashamed and confounded that seek after my soul: let them be turned backward, and put to confusion, that desire my hurt.
verses.pt: Fiquem envergonhados e confundidos os que procuram tirar-me a vida; tornem atrás e confundam-se os que me desejam o mal.
verses.en_web: Let them be disappointed and confounded who seek my soul. Let those who desire my ruin be turned back in disgrace.
verses.en_bbe: Let those who go after my soul have shame and trouble; let those who have evil designs against me be turned back and made foolish.

verses.en: Let them be turned back for a reward of their shame that say, Aha, aha.
verses.pt: Sejam cobertos de vergonha os que dizem: Ah! Ah!
verses.en_web: Let them be turned because of their shame Who say, “Aha! Aha!”
verses.en_bbe: Let those who say Aha, aha! be turned back as a reward of their shame.

verses.en: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: and let such as love thy salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.
verses.pt: Folguem e alegrem-se em ti todos os que te buscam; e aqueles que amam a tua salvação digam continuamente: engrandecido seja Deus.
verses.en_web: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let those who love your salvation continually say, “Let God be exalted!”
verses.en_bbe: Let all those who are looking for you be glad and have joy in you; let the lovers of your salvation ever say, May God be great.

verses.en: But I am poor and needy: make haste unto me, O God: thou art my help and my deliverer; O LORD, make no tarrying.
verses.pt: Eu, porém, estou aflito e necessitado; apressa-te em me valer, ó Deus. Tu és o meu amparo e o meu libertador; Senhor, não te detenhas.
verses.en_web: But I am poor and needy. Come to me quickly, God. You are my help and my deliverer. Yahweh, don’t delay.
verses.en_bbe: But I am poor and in need; come to me quickly, O God; you are my help and my saviour; let there be no waiting, O Lord.
